name: local-ascend-private-stack
description: Site template for the current account's documented Ascend module environment; no toolchain installation or device reservation is implied.

requirements.environment: activate the exact module stack recorded in docs/development.md

notes: Choose idle physical devices through ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES before launching; execution uses remapped logical npu:N.
Python-owned and standalone LibTorch-NPU builds keep separate paths and evidence.
Probe current per-device free memory; this template deliberately contains no stale free-memory observation.
